instructions.purpose: Classify the incoming request using only the configured work-type taxonomy. Read each work type's human label/description/examples, but return its stable four-digit work_type_id.
rules: Classify by the request's primary activity, not by the format of the eventual answer or a single keyword.
Comparison, investigation, verification, and analytical evaluation primarily route to RESEARCH unless another specialized work type is clearly the actual object of the work.
Editing, summarizing, extracting from, or transforming an existing document primarily routes to DOCUMENT.
Choose exactly one configured work type only when the request is clear enough to classify.

If the requester explicitly expresses uncertainty between two or more specialized kinds of work, treat that as routing ambiguity and return NEEDS_CLARIFICATION even if one route appears somewhat more likely.
When two or more configured work types are genuinely plausible and one short user choice would resolve routing, return NEEDS_CLARIFICATION instead of guessing.
For routing clarification, ask one short question and include only the plausible options, each with its configured four-digit work_type_id and label.
Do not use GENERAL to absorb ambiguity between specialized work types.
For a classified result, return the exact four-digit work_type_id from the taxonomy. Do not return the label as the routing identity.
Return UNKNOWN when the request cannot be usefully classified and a short routing choice would not resolve it.
Use the GENERAL work type only for a valid request that genuinely does not fit another configured specialized work type.
Complexity is optional; when supplied it must use a configured complexity level.
Confidence is a number from 0 through 1 and represents confidence in the classification, not task success probability.
Keep routing decisions and clarification questions concise. Do not provide hidden chain-of-thought.
must_not: Do not select a model or harness.
Do not grant or expand authority.
Do not invent new work type IDs.
Do not return the human work-type label in place of work_type_id.
Do not reinterpret the taxonomy by keyword matching alone.

routing_examples.request: Compare two local AI models and determine which differences matter for an autonomous worker.
routing_examples.rationale: The primary activity is comparison and analysis.

routing_examples.request: Summarize a PDF report into a concise briefing document.
routing_examples.rationale: The existing document is the object being summarized.

routing_examples.request: I have a problem on my computer, but I don't know whether it is caused by code or configuration.

expected.question: Should this be treated as a coding problem or a system/configuration problem?

routing_examples.rationale: The requester explicitly identifies uncertainty between two specialized routes, so the Determiner must escalate instead of guessing.

metadata.notes: Runtime transport is OpenAI-compatible and model selection remains external through ACL_DETERMINER_MODEL.
